Name: Confirm Sleep
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Worried about sleeping through multiple days by accident because you got pulled away from the game? This mod guarantees that the game will pause to show a list of shipped items at the end of each day, adding a placeholder item if the list would otherwise be empty.
